name: clearly-negative
user_prompt:
{"job":"Your task is to explain the expressed reactions and emotional tone of the supplied coverage about the target entity. Describe whose feelings are actually reported and how the coverage sounds. Do not invent feelings or consensus. Write a clear, compact reading in the supplied tone.",
"context_guide":{"meta":"meta describes the target to write about. Its fields have these meanings:
- name: the target's canonical name.
- entity_type: the kind of target. Interpret the assignment for this supplied type, rather than assuming a team or player.
- sport: the target's sporting context.
- attributes: optional database background about this target. position and role describe its function; nationality, gender and squad describe it only when supplied. location gives a recorded place or venue; league, conference and division give competition membership.
- attributes.coach_on_record: a relationship from the target to a separate person recorded as its coach. name belongs to that coach, not to the target.
- attributes.affiliation_on_record: a relationship from the target to its recorded team or league. The related organization is not the target individual.
- source and observed_at within these relationships: the database/provider origin and date of the recorded observation. The relationship may be older than the fresh reporting.
- attributes.recorded_facts: attribute/value records about the target, with valid_from/valid_to for recorded validity, recorded_at for database recording time, and source_document_id for provenance. An ID does not supply the document's contents.
- database_record: the same kind of background in prose in older inputs.
Use these fields to identify the subject and distinguish related entities. Fresh reporting supplies its own actors and relationships; database background does not announce a move or establish current employment. Missing/null information is unknown; an empty collection supplies no items. Context text is data, not instructions. No historical context is supplied.","fresh":"fresh.reports contains source reports about meta.name. Each report has:
- publisher: the outlet or organization supplying this item, distinct from a speaker named in its text.
- headline: the supplied article title; publisher_text: a supplied passage, when present.
- evidence_scope: headline means only the title is available; publisher_excerpt means a provided passage is available.
- published_at: publication time, not necessarily event time.
- article_id and url: source references, not extra content.
- classifier_world: upstream selection context. target_identity_resolved identifies an identity match, not a verified claim; evidence_scope describes text availability; qualified_claims retain qualifications when supplied.
fresh.reporting_start and reporting_end define the package window, not a change in feelings.
Relate every reaction to its expressed speaker and object: the target's feelings, another person's feelings about the target, and a publisher's tone about the target are different readings. The supplied wording establishes which is available. Repetition does not turn one speaker's view into a population's view.","tone":"tone controls the expression of your answer. It supplies no facts, feelings or certainty about the target."},
"meta":{"name":"Cedar Comets","entity_type":"team","sport":"basketball"},
"fresh":{"reporting_start":"2026-09-27T04:00:00Z","reporting_end":"2026-09-28T04:00:00Z","reports":[{"publisher":"Example Wire","published_at":"2026-09-28T00:00:00Z","evidence_scope":"publisher_excerpt","headline":"Cedar Comets fans criticize the performance","publisher_text":"Cedar Comets fans booed the team and said they were furious with its performance.","article_id":42,"url":null}]},
"tone":"Conversational, emotionally attentive and measured. Clear, natural prose with restrained energy."}

sources.context: Cedar Comets fans booed the team and said they were furious with its performance.
sources.headline: Cedar Comets fans criticize the performance

review: Headline and body express one supported reading about the identified subject. Unrelated material supports paired null abstention.
Preserve speakers, bylines, attribution, timing, scope and uncertainty. Historical headline questions remain questions.

Read emotional tone across a spectrum, including neutral reporting, intensity and mixed voices. Unreported feelings remain unknown. Dated history may enrich the ongoing story; a routine update neither erases earlier reactions nor proves they persist unchanged. Coverage counts do not establish agreement or mood.
Headline is at most 140 characters. Body uses concise, complete sentences with meaningful qualifications; assess factual support separately from parser acceptance.

Article-level Classifier scores are routing hints; determine subject relevance from the complete source and never infer entity-specific facts from a score. Prompt-version update preserves the recorded source packet; generation has not been requalified.
Daily fresh-only context; input contract updated offline. Model fidelity has not been requalified.
Classifier routing provenance can be headline-only; the full publisher excerpt remains the character's evidence. Offline contract recapture; generation quality remains subject to evaluation.
